own_solution.law: Equating gravitational and centripetal forces gives GM = gR² and T = 2π√((R+h)³/(gR²)). Converting distances to metres gives T = 5550.58 s = 92.5097 min. A current raise q replaces h by h+q.
assumptions: Use Newtonian gravity outside the stated spherical Earth.
Only Earth's gravity acts on the satellite, as stated.
An earlier mission precedes the explicitly specified current initial orbit.
A current raise results in the new circular orbit specified in the problem.
